name: @mountains/desktop
description: Mountains desktop shell. The engine stays in the main process.

scripts.pack: npm run bundle && npx --yes electron-builder@26.18.0 --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir --publish never
scripts.debug: node scripts/build.ts && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron scripts/debug.ts
scripts.release:mac: npm run bundle && npx --yes electron-builder@26.18.0 --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:windows: npm run bundle && npx --yes electron-builder@26.18.0 --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:windows:x64: npm run bundle && npx --yes electron-builder@26.18.0 --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
